target.title: fix(code-mode): report UTF-8 API file byte counts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Code Mode virtual API files reported JavaScript string length as `bytes`. MCP declaration files containing non-ASCII text were therefore shown with an underestimated byte count through both `API.list()` and `API.read()`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The worker now computes UTF-8 byte length at the Node host boundary before marshalling API files into QuickJS. The guest API reuses that canonical value for both list and read results.

## User Impact

Agents inspecting MCP declaration files receive accurate UTF-8 byte metadata, including declarations with internationalized descriptions.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: current head `eaaa1905d195d9ce8e0a3b70e8381d6f9bc6ed56` reports UTF-8 byte counts for Code Mode MCP API virtual files through both `API.list()` and `API.read()`.
- Real Code Mode runtime proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` using repo-local `createCodeModeTools()` / `applyCodeModeCatalog()` with an MCP declaration containing non-ASCII schema docs — passed with this redacted output:

```json
{
  "head": "eaaa1905d195d9ce8e0a3b70e8381d6f9bc6ed56",
  "status": "completed",
  "path": "mcp/github.d.ts",
  "listedBytes": 674,
  "readBytes": 674,
  "expectedUtf8Bytes": 674,
  "contentChars": 654,
  "hasNonAsciiDeclaration": true,
  "ownerDocPresent": true,
  "sameListReadBytes": true,
  "bytesExceedChars": true
}
```

- Focused real Code Mode/QuickJS regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/code-mode.test.ts -t "reports UTF-8 byte counts for MCP API files"` — passed (2 tests, 120 skipped by the name filter).
- Targeted formatting/lint/static checks: `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd --check src/agents/code-mode.worker.ts src/agents/code-mode.test.ts`, `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint.cmd src/agents/code-mode.worker.ts src/agents/code-mode.test.ts`, and `git diff --check` — all passed.
- Fresh autoreview: `python .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
